Chapter 9-15 material previously existed only inside the single 18-chapter synthesis document [A]; this is the first chapter-11-specific dedicated reading.' A's own row (S2059) contains exactly one brief correspondence-table line on Chapter 11 ('Ch11 (Visvarupa Darsana) restates the instrument/not-source non-doer principle via the cosmic-form revelation'), while B (S2221) expands this into a full ten-hypothesis (H11-1..H11-10) formal theory of bounded observer perspective (O_t != K, Unknown != Non-existent) culminating in a formal pipeline K--Omega-->O_t--B-->D_t--delta-->K_{t+1}.
p3a_pairs.what_would_make_this_wrong: If B's bounded-perspective theory were shown to conflict with (rather than elaborate) A's brief 'instrument/not-source non-doer' characterization of Chapter 11, COMPATIBLE would need to drop and the relationship might be closer to REDEFINITION.
